description: Register a slash command, or update it in place if the name is already taken. Pass a guild while iterating: guild commands appear immediately, while global commands can take up to an hour to show up everywhere and are rate limited per day. Subcommands and subcommand groups are not supported here.

bot.description: Which bot to act as, by name, when more than one is configured. Omit to use the default bot.

description.description: Shown to users in the command picker.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name.description: Command name without the slash, lowercase, no spaces.

choices.description: Fixed set of allowed values, for string, integer, and number options.

required.description: Whether the user must supply it.

name: register_app_command
title: Register app command
